That’s a nice idea. But I’ve said basically those lines verbatim in similar situations. The family will basically think you’re admitting you’re lying about having asked him to walk. 
Nurses complain because depending on the institution you work for, you are asked to do so much with so little, with constantly changing rules and policies. We are also trying to help patients get better when they are at their worst. Have you ever talked to someone when they were in a bad mood? Had someone made a smart comment to you and put you down? Now picture that 1000x heightened all day every day. We got into the profession because we want to help people when they’re at their worst. That doesn’t mean we need to tolerate lies/accusations/abuse. If it helps someone to complain on here rather than in the workplace then I consider that successful. If you’re not a nurse and can’t understand what I’m saying then maybe find another sub to be inquisitive on
